claim: NVIDIA's calendar Q3 2024 revenue was less than $30.9B according to the filing
summary: NVIDIA's filed quarter for Q3 2024 (fiscal Q3 FY2025 ended Oct 2024) reported revenue ~$35.1B, which is greater than $30.9B, so the claim that revenue was less than $30.9B according to the filing is false.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA's revenue for Q3 2024 (fiscal Q3 FY2025 ended October 2024) was less than $30.9B
sub_claims.note: From knowledge NVIDIA fiscal Q3 FY2025 ended Oct 2024, the filed quarter referred to as Q3 2024, reported revenue ~$35.1B, which exceeds $30.9B.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA's filing for that quarter supports revenue less than $30.9B
sub_claims.note: The filing for that quarter reports ~$35.1B, not a value less than $30.9B, so attribution of less-than value to filing is false.
